question.text: An institutional investor wants to use a Cat III AIF for ALPHA generation. This implies:

answer.text: Active management aiming to outperform benchmarks with skill-based strategies

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.7.1, alpha generation requires active management targeting mispriced securities and excess benchmark returns. The Trap: Passive/risk-free/dividend-only approaches don't generate alpha. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with XV, X-A portfolio theory. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Alpha claims need back-testing scrutiny — many 'alpha' managers are actually disguised beta bets.
